caption: The video depicts a woman in a long pale dress and matching headscarf standing in profile inside a dim room. She faces a tall arched double-leaf window through which bright hazy sunlight streams, illuminating dust and revealing trees and a balcony railing outside. A tall wooden cabinet stands at the left edge, while the right side fades into shadow. Her upper body leans forward at the waist, hands folded near her waist, and the bend deepens gradually. As she bows, her headscarf and dress fabric shift steadily forward over her bowed head and back. Her clasped hands lower with her torso, moving away from her waist and partly hidden by the dress. The window, light beam, and cabinet remain broadly unchanged, so the visible change is mainly her gradual bending motion.
relations: As her torso bends forward, headscarf and dress fabric shift steadily over her bowed head and back.
Her clasped hands lower with the bending torso, moving away from waist and partly hidden by dress.
The arched window, streaming light beam, and left cabinet remain broadly unchanged during her gradual bow.
